+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import test from "node:test";
+
+test("lint tooling preserves supported runtimes and hook invocation", async () => {
+  const [workflow, hooks, manifest, action] = await Promise.all([
+    readFile(".github/workflows/lint.yml", "utf8"),
+    readFile(".pre-commit-config.yaml", "utf8"),
+    readFile("package.json", "utf8"),
+    readFile("action.yml", "utf8"),
+  ]);
+
+  assert.match(workflow, /python-version: "3\.15"/);
+  assert.match(workflow, /python -m pip install pre-commit==4\.7\.0/);
+  assert.match(
+    workflow,
+    /run: pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage pre-push/,
+  );
+  assert.match(
+    hooks,
+    /repo: https:\/\/github\.com\/DavidAnson\/markdownlint-cli2\n    rev: v[\d.]+\n    hooks:\n      - id: markdownlint-cli2\n        name: Markdown Lint\n        args: \["--fix", "--config=\.markdownlint-cli2\.jsonc"\]\n        exclude: \^CHANGELOG\\\.md\$\n        stages: \[pre-commit, pre-push\]/,
+  );
+  assert.equal(JSON.parse(manifest).engines.node, ">=22");
+  assert.match(action, /using: "node24"/);
+});
+
+test("lint tooling uses the requested upstream releases", async () => {
+  const [workflow, hooks] = await Promise.all([
+    readFile(".github/workflows/lint.yml", "utf8"),
+    readFile(".pre-commit-config.yaml", "utf8"),
+  ]);
+
+  assert.match(
+    workflow,
+    /uses: actions\/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7\.1\.0/,
+  );
+  assert.match(
+    hooks,
+    /repo: https:\/\/github\.com\/DavidAnson\/markdownlint-cli2\n    rev: v0\.24\.0\n/,
+  );
+});
